tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī 7skyob pa'ajig rten gsum mgon gyi bka' 'bum gyi gleng brjod bzhugs so/ /par thengs gnyis
༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī 7skyob pa'ajig rten gsum mgon gyi bka' 'bum gyi gleng brjod bzhugs so/ /par thengs gnyis

tei:div.tei:p: "!#1$0000350༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī 7skyob pa'ajig rten gsum mgon gyi bka' 'bum gyi gleng brjod bzhugs so// par thengs gnyis pa// 1$0000270

"2 00#o00#y'das dus klu rigs sgron dang mar me mdzad// ma 'ongs byams pa da lta shākya thub// snyigs ma'i dus mthar 7skyob pa 'bri gung pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por gus phyag 'tshal/ byin rlabs brgyud pa'i mnga' bdag mar ston rje// lta spyod brgyud pa'i gzhung 'dzin a ti sha// bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres gaṅgā'i rgyun// thugs kyi bum par gtams mkhas sgam por mchod// zhi ba chen por mngon sangs rgyas kyang 'khor ba 'jig gi rnam sprul 'gyed// kha ba can 'dir 'dul bar dka' yang 'dren pa'i dpal du phag grur rol// kun bzang nags khrod mtha' rtsa dpal du dbyings dang rig pa'i chu gter bsrubs// zab dang rgya che snying po'i chos char 'beb mkhas 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru der 'dud// dri bral sems nyid gtsang ma'i shog bu ru// spros bral tshig gi ri mos mdzes pa 'di// dmigs bral rgyal ba rnams kyi dgyes mchod dang*// 'dzin bral don gnyis grub phyir ngal 'di brtsams// zhes mchod brjod kyis sngun bsus nas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'bri gung 7skyob pa 'jig rten mgon 1143 1217 po'i bka' 'bum ni tshig gi spros pas ma bslad cing*/ don rang gi nyams rtogs gnad du phog pa'i man ngag rnams/ nye gnas slob ma rnams kyi bka' 'dri zhus pa'i gsung lan du bstsal bar snang*/ bka' 'bum nang gi gsung phal che ba ni chos rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i gsung la brten par mdzad/ de yang rje yab sras gnyis kyi bka' 'bum ni rgyal ba'i bka' phal chen dang*/ dkon brtsegs gnyis la gzhi bcol nas gsung lugs bka' 'bum de nyid du gsal/ 7skyob pa'i phyi'i bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod 'di thog mar phyogs sgrigs mdzad po ni/ gtso bo dbon bsod nams grags pa (1187 1235)dang*/ dbon shes rab 'byung gnas/(1175 1255)

gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa sogs 7skyob pa'i dngos slob rnams kyis bsgrigs shing*/ 7skyob pa'i nang gi zab chos nor bu'i phreng ba 'go ma'i pod gnyis po phyogs bsgrigs sus mdzad kha gsal ma byung yang*/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen (1475 1527)gyi skabs su phyogs bsdus mdzad pa'i thog phyi ma'i pod gnyis ni rgyal dbang dkon mchog rin chen (1590 1654)dang*/ kun mkhyen chos kyi grags pa(1595 1659)gnyis khams phyogs su phebs bskyod skabs/ btsal 'tshol gyis phyogs bsgrigs kha gsab mdzad par zab chos khams byon skor zhes grags/ da yod 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum 'di rnams 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dbu brnyes nas lo ngo hril po sum brgya song ba'i rjes/ 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa bar dar gyi skabs su phyogs bsgrigs byung 'dug cing*/ sngar bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa thel du 'dus tshogs khri tsho bco brgyad dus gcig tu 'dus skabs/ zhal slob gtos che bas zhal gdams gsung mgur yang tshad las 'das pa zhig byung yod 'dug pa de ltar yang*/ da lta'i 'di rnams ni cha shas tsam zhig yin pa/ de yang gdan rabs gser phreng las/ da lta glegs bam du bzhugs pa 'di rnams yongs rdzogs ma yin par cha shas tsam mo// zhes gsal la/ da lta bod dang rgya bal sogs nas 7skyob pa'i gsung ji snyed cig rnyed son byung ba dag las kyang dpog par nus so// sngon 7rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi skabs su/ 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum mthing shog thog gser dngul spel mas bris mdzad pa'i pod tshad 'bring po(ka)nas(ca)bar yod pa'i thog /phyis byung 7skyabs rje zhi ba'i blo gros(1874 1943)dang*/ 7skyabs rje chos kyi blo gros (1869 1806)gnyis kyi skabs su/ da yod 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum shing par 'di'i nang gsar bsnon byung 'dug

de yang pod(ka)pa'i nang le'u tshan/ 8 (kha)pa'i nang le'u tshan/ 14 (ga)pa'i nang le tshan/ 5 (nga)pa'i nang le tshan/ 67 (ca)pa'i nang le tshan/ 146 bcas kha gsab byung 'dug 'di lam rig mdzod glog las nang 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum gsar du phyogs bsgrigs zhu skabs/ sngar yod shing dpar du 'khod pa'i thog gsar du kha gsab zhus pa'i grangs 'bor ni/ 7skyob pa'i zab chos nas bka' 'bum nang mnyam sdebs zhus pa'i le tshan bsdoms/ 133 dang*/ gsar du rnyed son byung ba bsdoms le tshan/ 16 bcas kha gsab zhus yod/ de min zab chos bka' rgya can sngar bzhugs dang*/ da lam gsar du rnyed son byung ba rnams bka' rgya ches dam drags pa'i dbang gis/ bka' 'bum dang zab chos gnyis ka'i nang du bcug thabs bral bas/ zur du skyob pa'i gsang ba'i zab chos pod gnyis phyogs bsgrigs kyis par skrun ma zhus par/ phyag chen sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi nyams len legs par grub pa rnams kyi spyod yul du bzhugs pa lags// //snga ma'i phyogs sgrigs/ bar lam lo ngo bcu phrag lhag tsam gyi ring la/ 'bri gung 7skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi bka' 'bum khag btsal 'tshol byed rgyur/ mi nor gnyis kyi ngal ba dang*/ nyen tshabs ji snyed cig brgyud/ da cha 'phags yul bla dwags khul dang*/ bal yul gle mi dang dol po khul/ bod nang khul dang rgya nag khul gyi dpe mdzod sogs nas/ 7skyob pa'i phyi yi bka' 'bum ma dpe tshar gsum dang*/ nang gi zab chos bka' 'bum bris dpe mi 'dra ba tshar bcu phrag tsam lag son byung bar brten/ da cha 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum khag chad lhag med par cha tshang po zhig sgrigs thub rgyu'i cha rkyen grub pas/ de ni hor gyis 'bri gung gling log bzo pa'i rjes su 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum da yod mjal yul du gyur pa rnams kyi nang nas cha tshang shos zhig tu gyur par gor ma chags/ 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum bal yul dol po khul dang*/

bod khul sku rten gzungs bzhugs kyi nang nas byung ba'i bka' 'bum 'thor bu de rigs kyi dpe gzugs ni/ zheng du sor bzhi dang*/ ring tshad dkyil mtho gang pa/ yig gzugs zhib la rkang pa ring ba/ de ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs kyi yig gzugs 'bru ma'i 'bri srol ldan lugs zhes/ ldan ma rtse mang gis srol btad pa'i lugs gnyis las/ 'bru chen gyi 'bri srol de yin par sems/ de'i nang gi yig 'bru rnams kyang*/ rgyal po'i bkas ma bcad pa'i gong gi 'bri srol ma nyams par snang bas/ snga shos su mthong*/ de rjes rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi skabs su/ rje de nyid kyis par byang smon tshig mdzad pa'i 7skyob pa'i phyi nang gi bka' 'bum cha tshang gser bris spus dag tu bris pa deng bod du bzhugs pa de yin pas/ de ni rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi shing yos/ 1495 dang*/ chu lug 1523 shing bya/ 1525 bcas snga rjes su yig mkhan bzhi brgya skor bsdus nas rgyal ba'i bka' dang*/ de'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos gangs can ljongs 'dir 'gyur ro cog mthing shog gi ngos la gser dngul spel mas bris skor/ 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi chos 'byung gdan rabs gser phreng du gsal ba de gras yin par nges/ de dus bris pa'i 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum gser bris de ni/ thog ma'i bka' 'bum phyogs bsgrigs kyi rang gzugs las ma nyams par spus dag shos su 'dug kyang*/ sngar bzhin bka' 'bum gyi le'u tshan so sor mtshan byang kha gsal med stabs/ le tshan stod smad dbye dka' ba dang*/ blta 'tshol yang dka' ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de rjes bla dwags phyi dbang dgon du yod pa'i 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum ka med sum cu'i sde tshan du sgrigs pa'i pod chen gcig byung 'dug bka' 'bum bris rnying de'i nang du'ang ka sde so sor mtshan byang bkod skabs/ phal che bar ka sde gcig gi nang du le tshan bcu phrag lhag mnyam sdebs byas par brten/

ka sde'i mtshan byang de dag gis thog ma'i le tshan de kho na'i nang don mtshon pa tsam las/ dpe tshan lhag ma rnams kyi nang don kha gsal ma thub pa'i skyon lhags/ de rting da cha tshang ma'i mjal yul du gyur pa 7skyob pa'i phyi'i bka' 'bum shing par mda' tshad ma pod lnga po de yin zhing*/ de ni 'bri gung 7skyabs rje zhi ba'i blo gros dang*/ 7skyabs rje chos kyi blo gros kyi skabs su rong mdo chos dbang rin po che dang*/ 'bri gung mkhan chen bsod nams kun dga' zhu ba dang*/ bshad grwa mkhan po a 'bol dang*/ mkhan po tshe ldan bzang po sogs gzhung lugs rig gnas la byang ba khag cig gis phyogs bsgrigs thog shing par du 'khod pa'i bka' mdzad/ de dus phyogs bsgrigs mdzad skabs dge mtshan che shos ni/ bka' 'bum(ca)pa de nang khyon le tshan 146 gsar du kha bsnon byung ba'i thog zhus dag kyang gang legs tsam byung 'dug slar yang mtshan byang gsar 'god mdzad skabs gong ltar le tshan thor bu rnams mnyam sdebs kyis/ spyi khyab tu 'gro ba'i mtshan byang bzos pa dper na/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro/ zhes dang*/ dga' ldan chos kyi dbyar rnga/ chu skyes bzhad pa'i dga' ston/ zhes pa la sogs pas mthus par mdzad de/ mtshan byang de rigs bka' pod so sos nang du phan tshun skyar zlos thengs mang byas pa ma zad/ pod gcig gi nang du'ang zlos skyon 'ga' byung*/ de ltar mdzes chos lta bus brgyan pa'i mtshan byang tsam gyis 'thus par byas pa'i khar/ bka' 'bum(ka)par mtshon na/ thub dbang dang*/ gu ru'i bstod thung thog mar bzhag thog /de rjes sher 'byung gis mdzad pa'i 7skyob pa'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus khag drug gsar 'dzud mdzad pa sogs/ thog ma'i bka' 'bum gyi sgrigs bzo las nyams pa'i thog 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum dang*/ spyan snga'i bka' 'bum gnyis kyang mnyam 'dres song ba'i skyon lhags pa sogs byung 'dug/ da lta'i sgrigs stangs/

1) dang thog 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum sgrigs phyogs thad/ rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag gis mjal bde ba'i ched nang don la zhigs nas/ sde tshan so sor dbye na dge mtshan che lugs dang*/ yang mkhas dbang gzhan gyi gsung 'bum la dpe blangs pa'i dgongs 'char yang lhag bsam dag pos gnang byung yang*/ 'dir 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum gyi le tshan go rim sgrigs stangs 'di ni/ 7skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa/ 7rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi skabs/ sngar gyi phyogs sgrigs ji bzhin bcos bslad med pa byed rgyu'i rtsa 'dzin byas pa yin/ 2) sngar 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bka' 'bum phal che bar bka' 'bum zhes 'khod cing*/ gzhan phal che bas gsung 'bum zhes bkod srol 'dug kyang*/ 'dir 7skyob pa'i gsung rnams rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma/ rten 'brel tshad ma/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung tshad ma/ rang gi nyams myong tshad ma bcas/ tshad ma bzhi po rtsa 'dzin gnang yod stabs 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum la bka' 'bum/ zhes rang 'jags bzhag nas gzhan 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gsung 'bum khag la gsung 'bum zhes bkod yod/ 3) da lam 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum rig mdzod 'phrul par nang gsar sgrigs byed skabs/ le tshan so sor mtshan byang kha gsal bkod yod cing*/ de yang le tshan phal che ba'i mtshan byang bka' 'bum rang gi nang du gsal yod cing*/ ma gsal pa rnams 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum bris rnying dpe thung de'i nang mtshan byang thung ngu re 'khod pa je rgyas su btang*/ de'i nang du'ang ma gsal ba rnams le tshan so so'i brjod bya dang rjod tshig gzhir bzung mtshan byang gsar 'god byas yod/ 4) da lan phyogs bsgrigs skabs 7skyob pa'i phyi'i bka' 'bum shing par nang sngar med 7skyob pa'i rnam thar drug po spyan snga'i gsung yin stabs/ tshur bton nas spyan snga'i bka' 'bum nang du phar btsud pa dang*/ 'bri gung pa'i phyag chen mtshan nyid ma zhes sems khrid bka' rgyas gdams pa de phyir 'then gyis skyob pa'i gsang ba'i zab chos kyi gras su btsud/

5) rgyal dbang kun dga'i skabs kyi skyob pa'i phyi'i bka' 'bum gser bris gzhi bcol sa de'i le tshan la 'gyur ba byung tshul ni/ ༈ gser bris ma'i le tshan la bzlos skyon byung ba(kha)pa ldeb 122ba2 dang*/(ga)ldeb 80ba3 gnyis bzlos pas phyi ma 'then/(kha)ldeb 53ba2 dang*/(kha) 69na2 gnyis bzlos pas phyi ma 'then/(ga) 39na2 dang*/(kha) 121na3 gnyis bzlos pas phyi ma 'then/ yang(ga)ldeb 27na6 'phags pa sprin chen po'i char 'bebs kyi cho ga de mdo mang dang gcig pas phyir 'then zhus/ ༈ de bzhin shing par(ca)nang*/ ldeb 132 nas 170 bar spyan snga sher 'byung gis mdzad pa'i sgo mang gi lo rgyus dang*/ pod de nyid ldeb 177 nas 179 bar spyan snga sher 'byung gis mdzad pa'i nges pa don gyi bstod pa gnyis phyir 'then zhus te/ spyan snga bka' 'bum nang du phar btsud/ ༈ 7skyob pa'i zab chos nang phan tshun bzlos skyon byung ba zab chos(ma) 66 dang*/ le tshan(a)gnyis bzlos pas phyi ma 'then/ yang zab chos (ca)ldeb 9 pa dang*/ le tshan (sa)gnyis bzlos pas phyi ma 'then/ ༈ 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum dang zab chos gnyis phan tshun bzlos skyon byung ba ni 7skyob pa'i zab chos le tshan(je )dang*/ bka' 'bum(ka) 245ba5 gnyis bzlos pas phyi ma 'then/ yang zab chos(ti)dang*/ bka' 'bum(ka)ldeb 23 gnyis bzlos pas zab chos nas 'then/ ༈ yang tshig bzlos skyon byung ba 7skyob pa'i bka' 'bum bod byon gser bris (kha)ldeb 46ba3 nas 47 na 4 bar mthol pas phyir 'then byas/ yang shing par(ca)yang shing par(ca) 53na5 (de nyid dbyer med du gnas pa de la gzhi'i zung 'jug bya ba lags/) zhes pa de mthol 'dug pas phyir 'then byas yod/par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su kha skong byas pa rnams rtags 'di ྂ can khag gsar du kha skong zhus pa yin/ 6) da lam skyob pa'i bka' 'bum phyogs sgrigs kyi las don skabs/ spus tshad ang dang por bzhag stabs/ dus yun 'gor gzhi che yang*/

zhus dag la smar zhus dang*/ bskyar zhus/ yang tig gzigs 'bebs/ gtan 'bebs bcas thengs lnga las mi nyung ba byas shing*/ brda rnying pa don mang la 'jug pa dag nor gzhir 'gyur dogs kyis dmigs su mchan bu btags/ de min bcos dgos rnams ma dpe rnying shos der khungs btugs nas bcos/ tshig mdzod sogs nas ma gsal ba dang*/ yul skad sogs ji yin ma shes pa bcos thabs med pa rnams rang sor bzhag yod pa bcas 'di las lhag pa'i bcos thabs med pa lta bu yin yang*/ slad mkhas pa'i dbang po dag gis bcos dgos rigs shar tshe yig 'bru re bcos dgos kyang nges par du rgyu mtshan mchan bu kha gsal sbyar te bcos mkhan gyi ming bcas kha gsal dgos pa chos klong du bsti ba zhu/ thog ma'i ma phyi rig mdzod glog nang par rtsa bcug mkhan ni/ skal bzang chos 'phel dang*/ g.yu ru dkon mchog chos dbang*/ phyi dbang tshe dbang rdo rje/ byang gling tshul khrims dge legs/ lung dkar dgon bstan 'dzin zla ba/ par thengs dang po'i dpe gzugs bsgrigs bkod nyi lcang dkon mchog nor bu dang*/ da lan par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs dpe gzugs sgrig bkod dang tha ma'i las gzhi tshang ma skal bzang chos 'phel gyis byas/ zhus dag 'gan khur gtso bo ngos dang*/ skal bzang chos 'phel gnyis kyis bgyis pas/ 'bri gung 7skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' 'bum gsar du phyogs bsgrigs zhus pa 'di 'bri gung bka' brgyud srung rab nyams gso khang nas rgyal sa ldi lir par thengs gnyis pa par skrun zhus shing*/ 'di ltar byas dang byed bzhin gyi dge rtsa rnams tshogs gnyis rlabs po che'i 'jug ngogs su gzhol zhing*/ 'di phyi bstan 'gro'i dge 'bras g.yur du bza' ba gyur cig gu zhes smon 'dun gyis mtshams sbyar te/ legs byas dge ba ri bong 'dzin ltar cha shas yongs su gang ba 'di// rgyal ba'i bstan pa tsha zer rab 'bar gtsug lag pad tshal phyogs bcur rgyas// bstan 'dzin 'dab stong yongs suu grol nas nges don snying po sbrang rtsis gtams// bdag gzhan 'gro kun sum rtsen gnas ltar bde skyid dpal la longs spyod shog/

7rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i mtshan gyis byin gyi brlabs pa/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin kun bzang phrin las lhun grub kyis/ bya lo mngon par byang chub pa'i nyer lngar/ 7skyob pa'i dgongs rdzogs dus mchod chen mor mchod dod kyi tshul du par skrun gleng brjod du spel ba dge'o// //dge'o/ dge'o/// /

1$0000350༈ par thengs gnyis pa'i dpe skrun gsal bshad/1$0000270 rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog phyan na padmo'i thugs rje'i grib bsil/ klu sgrub gnyis pa skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi rgyal tshab/ 'o skol rnams la bka' drin sgo kun nas mtshungs pa med pa'i 'dren mchog 'bri gung 7skyabs mgon nyi zla zung gi thugs bskyed phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus su babs pa'i skabs 7skyabs mgon dkon mchog bstan 'dzin kun bzang phrin las lhun grub dpal bzang po mchog gong ma rim byon gyi mdzad pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa las lhag pa'i sku ngal brgya phrag du ma lhur bzhes mdzad de lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas/ nyams pa slar gso/ mi nyams rgyud 'dzin gnang ba'i bstan 'gro'i mdzad pa grangs las 'das pa'i nang tshan gal che ba bod kyi rig gzhung spyi dang*/ bye brag 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi phyag dpe rnams dus 'gyur mi zad pa rim byung gis dpe rgyun ches cher dkon pa'i skabs 'dir/ mgon po gang gis 'dzam gling shar nub yul gru kun nas ma dpe 'tshol zhib gnang dang gnang bzhin pa'i thugs rje'i bka' drin la brten 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gsung rab mang dag cig da cha rig mdzod 'phrul par thog gsar du par skrun thub pa byung ba'i nang tshan skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon bka' 'bum gyi phyi'i bka' 'bum pod ka)nas cha)bar dang*/ nang gi zab chos pod ja) nas ta)bar pod gsum/ bka' 'bum kha skong pod tha) nas na)bar bcas bka' 'bum pod bcu gnyis par thengs dang po spyi lo 2000 lor par skrun cha tshang zin yang*/ pod na)pa pod tshad ma lon pa da lan par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs chos tshan zhal skong zhus pa gsham gsal/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zab chos rnal 'byor bzhi ldan/ thabs lam gsal ba'i sgron me/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i bstod pa/

bde mchog dril bu ri'i gnas bshad/ lnga ldan shog khra ma'i rgyab chos/ rje'i tshig gsum gnad kyi gdams pa/ sku gshegs kha'i zhal chems dbon shes rab 'byung gnas kyis yi ger btab pa/ sku gshegs khar nye gnas rnams kyis sgrub pa byed pa'i dam bca' phul ba la gsungs pa/ 'chi ba blu ba/ gtum mo'i lo rgyus/ smon lam bsdus pa/ yi ge 'bri tshul tsheg phrad ji bzhin dgos par gdams pa/ a phyi'i bskang ba bka' rgya ma bcas zhal skong zhus yod/ da lan par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs bskyar du zhus dag thengs gnyis dang*/ gsang ba'i zab chos pod gnyis ma dpe ma 'dra ba bcu tsam phan tshun go bsdur gyis zhus dag byas yod/ de sngon par thengs gnyis pa'i skabs par skrun ma zhus pa shin tu bka' rgya che ba'i gsang ba'i zab chos pod gnyis da lan thengs gcig par skrun ma zhus tshe slad ma phyi rig mdzod nang nas brlag gtor shor nyen che bas/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i nyams len legs par grub pa'i sgrub grwa rnam pa'i ched tshar grangs brgya tham pa par skrun zhus yod/ thengs 'di'i par skrun skabs pod ka)nas/ ga)bar gyi dbu lha rnams zab mo lta brgyud dang*/ nga) nas/ cha)bar rgya chen spyod brgyud/ ja)bka' babs dang po/ nya)bka' babs gnyis pa/ ta)bka' babs gsum pa/ tha)bka' babs bzhi pa/ da)nas/ pha)bar rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bcas cung zad bsdus te bkod pa yin/ dbu lha'i ri mo phal che ba gzhis rtse kha rag lha bris bu chung lags nas bris gnang mdzad pa dang*/ lo tsā ba kro nis lags nas bod yig 1$0000140Program TibetDoc1$0000270rim pa gsar shos dang*/ tshig mdzod 'dra min bcas lhag bsam chen pos rin med zhal 'debs gnang ba bcas 'bri gung bka' brgyud gsung nyams gso khang las gzhi legs grub kyi mthun 'gyur mkhan rnams la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ ldi li 'bri gung bka' brgyud gsung rab nyams gso khang las 'go tshugs nas lo lnga'i ring gsung rab par skrun zhus pa'i dkar chag rob bsdus tsam ni/
